result_text:
I added `DataStore.listOverduePurchaseOrdersBySupplier(long supplierId, LocalDate date)` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, next to the warehouse version. It compiles, but I didn't write or run any tests for it.

It returns the supplier's purchase orders with status `SENT` and an expected date strictly before the given date, ordered by expected date and then id, each with its order lines. An order expected on the date itself isn't included, and draft, received and cancelled orders never are.

It copies the structure of the existing `listOverduePurchaseOrdersByWarehouse` method, including its duplicated line-loading code, rather than refactoring. I didn't touch `DemoScenario`.
